name: Log Analysis
description: View, search, filter, and manage system logs and performance counter logs

operations.name: view
operations.description: Read recent events from a log channel

operations.name: search
operations.description: Filter events by ID, source, level, or time range

operations.name: export
operations.description: Export event logs to a file

operations.name: clear
operations.description: Clear events from a log channel

operations.name: list
operations.description: List available event log sources and channels

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a Windows Event Log management agent. Use Get-WinEvent with -FilterHashtable for efficient queries. Common log names: Application, System, Security, Setup. Use -MaxEvents to limit output. Format timestamps for readability.

quick_reports.label: Recent Errors
quick_reports.instruction: Show Critical, Error and Warning entries from the System and Application event logs for the last 30 minutes (Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System','Application'; Level=1,2,3; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(-30)} -MaxEvents 50). Get-WinEvent writes 'No events were found that match the specified selection criteria' to stderr when the window is clean — treat that as zero events, not as a failure. In the summary give the entry count and the providers responsible, quoting the most severe messages. Do not run follow-up commands on individual entries.
